evaluation.caveat: Descriptive synthetic-game sample, not a strength claim; truncations excluded from score and W/D/L summaries.
evaluation.comparison: Frozen initial and trained stochastic policies versus uniform random; identical paired seeds and seats.

paired_comparison.unit: scenario seed; mean of BLUE and RED own-score deltas
paired_comparison.caveat: Descriptive sample standard error across scenario seeds, not a confidence interval or proof of improvement. Both seats of a seed are correlated; incomplete pairs are excluded.

provenance.note: Original generated demo fixture, not a real scenario or external service snapshot. Existing game data and rules are unchanged.

confirmation_design: Additional frozen confirmation set chosen after observing favorable 32-pair results at seeds 2400000..2400031; no checkpoint selection or further training. All 64 new pairs retained. Evaluation stops after this set.
